title: Selected Stories (1995-2009)

vibeProfile.oneLine: Later Alice Munro, folding time and memory into perfect stories.

summary: The second volume of selected Alice Munro gathers her later stories, which grow, if anything, deeper and more daring in how they fold time, memory and revelation into a single narrative. Still rooted in small-town Canadian life, these are the works of a writer at the height of her powers, quietly rewriting what a short story can hold. Together with the first volume it makes the case, in the most understated way, for Munro as a giant of modern fiction.
whyReadIt: Later Munro, deeper and more daring with time and memory. The second half of a quiet giant's life work.

funFacts.text: Munro announced her retirement from writing shortly before winning the Nobel Prize.
